changes_made.explanation: Consolidated datasets (removed duplicates), kept only NLG models used for generation, removed preprocessing tools (SpeechBrain, CRAFT, CRNN) as they are not NLG models being evaluated
SacreBLEU is an implementation of BLEU, so normalized to base form BLEU. Kept BLEU and chrF as the core evaluation metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. Kept all fields empty as no such evaluation was performed.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper. Evaluation was conducted solely using automatic metrics (BLEU, chrF).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on robustness for neural machine translation using adapter-based methods. Evaluation is exclusively automatic using BLEU and chrF scores. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluations were conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of duplicate dataset names and removal of preprocessing tools that weren't NLG models.
